how_found: Web search surfaced the BFUHS counseling Google Site (sites.google.com/wnesu.com/bfuhscounseling) > Program of Studies (embedded Google Doc); also school site bfuhs.wnesu.org > Learning > Program of Studies (webpage version).
issues: The only catalog is a two-year '2024-2026' Program of Studies (47 pages, full descriptions, graduation requirements on p.2). It nominally covers 2024-25 and 2025-26; no 2026-27 edition found though it is still the one linked in Nov 2026, so it may effectively still be in use. Year recorded as '2024-26' (not a single school year). The official Finalsite site also presents the catalog as multi-page HTML (one page per department, undated); only the landing page was saved, not crawled. Google Doc export worked without sign-in. No course-planning tool found on the counseling site or school site.
